errors.over_download_limit: The repository exceeds the download limit
errors.archive_too_big: The repository archive is over 1 GB compressed
errors.download_timeout: The download took over {{minutes}} min ({{mb}} MB received); check the connection to {{provider}}
errors.provider_in_development: {{provider}} is still in development and can't be used yet; meanwhile, analyze its repositories with `scan` in CI
errors.list_failed: Couldn't list repositories; check the token and its permissions
errors.decompression_bomb: The archive expands out of all proportion; it was discarded as a possible decompression bomb
errors.not_available: Repository not available with the configured credential
errors.connect_first: Connect the code provider before analyzing

progress.downloaded: Download complete ({{mb}} MB). Extracting the files that can be analyzed…

domains.https_only: Use an HTTPS URL on a public domain, with no user, port, query or fragment
domains.limit: You've reached the maximum number of registered domains
domains.txt_missing: The verification TXT record wasn't found; check the name, the value and propagation
domains.not_verified: {{host}} has no current DNS proof: verify it again before scanning it
domains.proof_gone: The TXT record of {{host}} is gone, so it no longer counts as verified: publish it and verify again

check.dns_error: The domain doesn't resolve in DNS.
check.private_address: The domain resolves to a private or reserved address; it isn't probed.
check.tls_error: The TLS certificate isn't valid for this host.

domains.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts for this domain; try again in {{seconds}} s
domains.invalid_method: Use dns, file or meta as the verification method
domains.proof_unreachable: Couldn't reach {{host}} over HTTPS to check its proof; try again later
domains.redirected: {{url}} answered with a redirect ({{code}}): the proof must be served by that exact host, without redirects
domains.file_missing: {{url}} doesn't contain this domain's token: publish the file with the token in it and make sure it answers 200
domains.meta_missing: The homepage of {{host}} has no pitangus-verify meta tag with this domain's token
domains.proof_gone_file: The verification file of {{host}} is gone, so it no longer counts as verified: publish it again and verify
domains.proof_gone_meta: The verification meta tag of {{host}} is gone, so it no longer counts as verified: add it again and verify

scope.too_many: A scan lists at most {{max}} extra hosts
scope.invalid_host: {{host}} isn't a valid host name (use name.example.com or *.example.com)
scope.outside: {{host}} isn't {{root}} or one of its subdomains
scope.needs_dns: {{host}} can't be scanned: {{root}} was verified with a file or a meta tag, which proves that host only. Verify it with the DNS TXT record to include subdomains
scope.unverified: Verify {{host}} first: only a verified domain's subdomains can be included
scope.dns_only: Verify with DNS to include subdomains
scope.root: {{host}} is the domain itself: it's always analyzed
scope.unknown_host: {{host}} isn't among this domain's related hosts
scope.hosts_full: A domain keeps at most {{max}} related hosts
scope.not_manual: {{host}} was found by discovery and stays listed: exclude it instead

schedule.invalid: The schedule is weekly or off
schedule.lapsed: Skipped: the domain's proof lapsed. Verify it again and the weekly scan resumes at the next round
schedule.busy: Waiting: another web scan was queued or running; it is tried again at the next round

headers.invalid_name: Header names use letters, digits and !#$%&'*+.^_`|~- only, up to 64 characters
headers.denied_name: {{name}} is set by the connection itself and can't be saved
headers.invalid_value: Header values are printable ASCII on one line, up to {{max}} characters
headers.limit: A domain keeps at most {{max}} headers

discovery.interrupted: The search for related hosts stopped without finishing; search again.
discovery.busy: A search for related hosts is already running for this domain.
